mappings.note: What the gopis said and how Uddhav was left - narrative comprehension of the pad, not an aesthetic reading (LO-7).
Asks both the upamaan for Uddhav and the barb in 'samachar sab paae' - comparison plus vyangya, so LO-7 over LO-6.
Their view of the yoga-marg, stated plainly - kaavyabodh rather than kala-paksh.
Chief features of Bhramargeet as poetry - a kala-paksh judgement; C-H1.3 rejected because the evidence is the set pad, not literary history.
Which changes in Krishna the gopis point to - comprehension of the argument they build.
